title: Orders: a test copy that took real money can be refunded
why: Jason, 2026-11-19, on the order map's chargeFor bug: "Fix in first release." QuickBooksPay::chargeFor refused test copies before looking up the card, against guardReal's own rule (Jason, 2026-11-10: refunds only send money back, so a test copy that once took real money can still be refunded). decisions/0101's note of 2026-11-20 (rulings on the order map).
